scenes.headline: Query Optimization
scenes.subtitle: Read less, shuffle less, finish faster
scenes.narration: Query optimization on Databricks combines file layout, statistics, and Spark features to minimize work per query.

scenes.headline: The main levers
items: Data skipping via Z-order and clustering
Broadcast joins and adaptive query execution
scenes.narration: Good file layout lets Delta skip files that cannot match your filters. Partition pruning and pushed-down predicates avoid reading irrelevant data. Broadcasting small tables and adaptive execution reduce costly shuffles.

scenes.headline: Diagnosing and improving a query
scenes.narration: EXPLAIN reveals the physical plan, join strategy, and where scans dominate. Z-ordering on the filter and join keys enables aggressive data skipping. Refreshing statistics helps the optimizer pick better join and shuffle strategies.

scenes.headline: Optimization workflow
scenes.narration: Start by reading the query plan to locate the costliest operation. Address it with better clustering, statistics, or join hints. Then re-measure to confirm the improvement before moving on.

scenes.headline: Watch for these red flags
items: Skewed partitions overloading a few tasks
scenes.narration: A full scan on a selective query means data skipping is not working. Big exchange operators point to shuffles you may be able to avoid. Task skew from uneven keys often causes one slow straggler to dominate runtime.

scenes.text: The fastest data to process is the data you never read.
scenes.narration: Optimize layout and statistics first, and let the engine skip everything it can.
